name: classify_post
description: Classify a blog post into a domain, one or more collections, and topics.

domain_index.description: Index into existing_domains list. Use -1 to propose a new domain.

new_domain.description: Empty unless domain_index == -1; otherwise the proposed new domain name.

new_domain_desc.description: Empty unless domain_index == -1; otherwise a one-sentence description of the proposed domain (what it covers, not the specific post). Stored alongside the domain row.

collections.description: Ordered list of collections this post belongs to within the chosen domain. Index 0 is the PRIMARY (post's home). Indices 1+ are SECONDARY memberships used only when the post substantively contributes to that category (not just mentions/compares against it). Use index=-1 to propose a new collection (new_name + new_desc required); existing-index entries must leave new_name and new_desc empty.

index.description: Index of an existing collection within the chosen domain (as shown in the tree). Use -1 to propose a new collection.

new_name.description: Empty unless index == -1; otherwise the proposed new collection name.

new_desc.description: Empty unless index == -1; otherwise a one-sentence description of the proposed collection (what family of work it groups, not this specific post). Stored alongside the collection row.

topics.description: Topics naming the post's salient semantic concepts. Each topic must be distinct from entities, from the chosen domain/collection, and from structural metadata, and should pass the linking/reusability/specificity tests.
